name: Whooshly
description: Creates short links, dynamic QR codes, UTM templates, vCards and landing pages, and reads click and scan analytics via an OAuth-gated MCP server, a bearer-token REST API and a Chrome extension.

skills.name: Short Link Management
skills.description: Creates and updates branded short links with custom slugs and titles through the /api/links endpoints.

skills.name: Link Click Analytics
skills.description: Reads click and scan counts for an individual short link from the /api/links/{id}/stats endpoint.

skills.name: Dynamic QR Codes
skills.description: Generates dynamic QR codes via /api/qr and returns a scannable image whose destination can be changed after printing.

skills.name: UTM Templates
skills.description: Builds and lists reusable UTM templates through /api/utm so campaign source, medium and campaign tags stay consistent.

skills.name: Digital Business Cards
skills.description: Creates shareable vCard digital business cards with name, title, email and phone through the /api/vcard endpoint.

skills.name: Landing Pages
skills.description: Creates and updates hosted landing pages with headlines and lead-capture forms through the /api/pages endpoints.
